Bible Reading Through the Year: Daily Index

Daily Audio Bible one-year plan · January 1 – December 31, 2027

0 of 365 days finishedGo to next unfinished day ›

For each day: the reading, with links to that day's Daily Audio Bible podcast episode in Spanish and English; each video with a link and its length; what happens at that place in the day's reading; and whether the film is new or a repeat. Promised Land films and Daily Audio Bible (DAB) book introductions are in the Daily Audio Bible app (Community › Watch, or Related Visuals in each day's episode player); their links open the app. BibleProject links open the German video, with the English version below it. Verses are quoted from the King James Version. 110 different Promised Land films; about 56 hours of video in all. The podcast links play the most recent recording of that day's episode; now and then the Spanish episode splits a New Testament passage a few verses differently.

Ticking off a day: tick the box by the reading and by each video as you finish it. When everything for a day is ticked, the day turns green. “Done” in the date column ticks the whole day at once. Ticks are saved in this browser on this device only, so use the same device and browser each time.
